grammar_title: 不定式(to do):作目的状语 / 作后置定语 / 作宾语·宾补·主语(与 doing 对照)
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 4 Discovering Useful Structures:不定式 to do 的用法。句子地道、围绕太空探索主题、to 不定式为唯一正确填法,干扰项为 doing / for doing / done / do(bare)。

points.point: 不定式作目的状语(to do / in order to do / so as to do)
points.overview: 表示动作的目的,用 to do(也可 in order to / so as to + do)。回答 why、强调'为了……',不可用 doing/done。

points.point: 不定式作后置定语(the first person to do / something to eat)
points.overview: 不定式放在名词后修饰它,表示'要做、将做'的动作,如 the first person to do、a lot of work to do、the best way to do、something to eat。

points.point: 不定式作宾语/宾补/主语(want/decide to do · ask sb to do · It is … to do),与 doing 对照
points.overview: want/decide/hope/need 等后接 to do;ask/tell/allow/want sb to do 作宾补;It is … to do 作真主语。由动词搭配决定用 to do 还是 doing。

questions.stem: Scientists make special vehicles ____ brave people into space.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了运送'→ 不定式 to carry。

questions.stem: An astronaut needs to be calm ____ in space safely.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了在太空工作'→ to work。

questions.stem: Astronauts collect dirty water so as ____ it for later use.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的 → to recycle。

questions.stem: They stuck everything down in order ____ things floating off.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的 → to stop。

questions.stem: Voyager 1 was launched ____ deep space far from Earth.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了研究'→ to study。

questions.stem: He trained for years ____ a fighter pilot before joining the programme.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了成为'→ to become。

questions.stem: China sent Chang'e 4 to the moon so as ____ the far side.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的 → to explore。

questions.stem: Astronauts exercise every day in order ____ healthy in space.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的 → to stay。

questions.stem: Tianzhou 1 was sent up ____ with the space lab.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了对接'→ to dock。

questions.stem: Scientists are growing crops in space ____ astronauts enough food.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了给'→ to give。

questions.stem: We must save resources so as ____ them from running out.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的 → to prevent。

questions.stem: He stayed up late ____ the report on the space mission.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了完成'→ to finish。

questions.stem: Satellites were placed in orbit ____ weather patterns on Earth.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了记录'→ to record。

questions.stem: Engineers checked the rocket carefully in order ____ any accidents.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的 → to avoid。

questions.stem: The crew moved slowly during the spacewalk so as ____ their bodies under control.
questions.explanation: so as to do 表目的 → to keep。

questions.stem: Many countries spend billions ____ the secrets of the universe.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了找出'→ to find。

questions.stem: She studied physics hard ____ a place in the space programme.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了赢得'→ to win。

questions.stem: The team built a new lab in order ____ life in space for longer.
questions.explanation: in order to do 表目的 → to support。

questions.stem: Astronauts attach themselves to the wall so as ____ around while they sleep.
questions.explanation: so as not to do 表目的(否定)→ not to float。

questions.stem: They sent a rover to Mars ____ measurements of the surface.
questions.explanation: 表目的'为了进行(测量)'→ to make。

questions.stem: Yuri Gagarin was the first person in the world ____ into space.
questions.explanation: the first person to do 后置定语 → to go。

questions.stem: Yuri Malenchenko became the first person ____ married in space.
questions.explanation: the first person to do 后置定语 → to get。

questions.stem: Astronauts always have a lot of work ____ on the station.
questions.explanation: 名词 work 后接不定式作定语 → to do。

questions.stem: Building rockets is the best way ____ Earth's gravity.
questions.explanation: the best way to do 后置定语 → to escape。

questions.stem: Neil Armstrong was the first man ____ on the moon.
questions.explanation: the first man to do 后置定语 → to step。

questions.stem: In space, astronauts need something ____ to keep up their energy.
questions.explanation: something to eat 后置定语 → to eat。

questions.stem: China was the third country ____ humans into space on its own.
questions.explanation: the third country to do 后置定语 → to send。

questions.stem: There is still much ____ about the far side of the moon.
questions.explanation: much (名词) 后接不定式作定语 → to learn。

questions.stem: Laika was the first living thing ____ into orbit around Earth.
questions.explanation: the first … thing to do 后置定语 → to go。

questions.stem: Sleeping bags are the safest way ____ floating around at night.
questions.explanation: the safest way to do 后置定语 → to avoid。

questions.stem: Captain Brown had little free time ____ during his stay in space.
questions.explanation: time 后接不定式作定语 → to enjoy。

questions.stem: Yang Liwei was the first Chinese astronaut ____ Earth in a spacecraft.
questions.explanation: the first … astronaut to do 后置定语 → to orbit。

questions.stem: They were looking for a good place ____ the new space station.
questions.explanation: place to do 后置定语 → to build。

questions.stem: On the long journey there is never enough water ____.
questions.explanation: water to drink 后置定语 → to drink。

questions.stem: Shenzhou 7 carried the first Chinese astronaut ____ a spacewalk.
questions.explanation: the first … to do 后置定语 → to take。

questions.stem: Mars may be the next planet ____ by human beings.
questions.explanation: the next planet to explore 后置定语(被动含义由语境承担)→ to explore。

questions.stem: There were many requirements ____ before he could join the programme.
questions.explanation: requirements to meet 后置定语 → to meet。

questions.stem: Voyager 1 was the first spacecraft ____ deep space so far away.
questions.explanation: the first spacecraft to do 后置定语 → to reach。

questions.stem: Living on Mars may become the only choice ____ for humans one day.
questions.explanation: the only choice (left) to do 后置定语 → to leave。

questions.stem: She felt proud to be the first member of her family ____ a scientist.
questions.explanation: the first member to do 后置定语 → to become。

questions.stem: Some scientists were determined ____ humans realise their dream.
questions.explanation: be determined to do → to help。

questions.stem: Captain Brown looked forward ____ his family after the mission. (avoid 'forward to')
questions.explanation: look forward to + doing(to 是介词)→ to seeing。

questions.stem: It is dangerous ____ out of orbit and back to Earth's surface.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do 真主语 → to get。

questions.stem: The captain told the new crew member ____ his seatbelt at once.
questions.explanation: tell sb to do 作宾补 → to fasten。

questions.stem: Mr Yang always hoped ____ an astronaut one day.
questions.explanation: hope to do → to become。

questions.stem: Astronauts can't avoid ____ around when there is no gravity.
questions.explanation: avoid + doing(不接 to do)→ floating。

questions.stem: Mission Control wants every astronaut ____ the safety rules carefully.
questions.explanation: want sb to do 作宾补 → to follow。

questions.stem: The team kept ____ until the spacecraft finally docked.
questions.explanation: keep + doing(不接 to do)→ trying。

questions.stem: The space agency decided ____ a rover to the far side of the moon.
questions.explanation: decide to do → to send。

questions.stem: Living in space for months means ____ your muscles every day.
questions.explanation: mean doing 意味着做某事 → exercising。

questions.stem: The rules do not allow anyone ____ the station without a spacesuit.
questions.explanation: allow sb to do 作宾补 → to leave。

questions.stem: After the long mission, he enjoyed ____ at the blue Earth below.
questions.explanation: enjoy + doing(不接 to do)→ looking。

questions.stem: It is not easy ____ people to planets beyond the solar system.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do 真主语 → to send。

questions.stem: The doctor suggested ____ regularly to keep the muscles strong.
questions.explanation: suggest + doing(不接 to do)→ exercising。

questions.stem: The captain asked the crew ____ enough food for the long journey.
questions.explanation: ask sb to do 作宾补 → to store。

questions.stem: We can't risk ____ all our oxygen so early in the mission.
questions.explanation: risk + doing(不接 to do)→ losing。

questions.stem: The crew needs ____ the data back to Earth as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: need to do → to transmit。

questions.stem: Scientists are busy ____ a way to travel faster through space.
questions.explanation: be busy + doing 忙于做 → finding。

questions.stem: Houston warned the astronauts not ____ their oxygen too quickly.
questions.explanation: warn sb not to do 作宾补(否定)→ not to use。

questions.stem: It is important ____ astronauts both mentally and physically.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do 真主语 → to prepare。
